ABOUT PLEO

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

INTRO

At Pleo, we’re on a mission to revolutionise the way businesses manage company spending. No more outdated processes, clunky spreadsheets, or frustrating delays - we believe spend management should be seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike. We’re creating tools that promote autonomy, foster trust, and let businesses focus on what truly matters.

Our culture is built on transparency, collaboration, and a deep commitment to innovation – which is reflected in our spending solution. At Pleo, you’ll join a passionate team shaping the future of work, all while having some fun along the way.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a high-performing and dynamic Billing Operations Analyst to join our Finance Team at Pleo. This role is a unique opportunity to actively support the business to reach new milestones having in mind people growth and great team work. If you enjoy working at the intersection of Billing, Accounting and Automation – and want to help drive the future direction of Pleo – we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Billing Operations Analyst, you will:

- Review, approve & process credit note requests

- Review contracts & account setup accuracy when the need arises.

- Answer internal billing questions in a timely & professional manner, including escalations.

- Guide GTM & other teams on billing best practices

- Reissue invoices

- Create & maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Process refunds.

- Drive internal projects from concept to completion.

- Complete Month-End Close activities as required.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Have 1+ year experience in a Finance/Accounting/Operations related field, with basic knowledge on Internal Accounting Standards (IFRS)

- Have advanced excel skills including formulas sage and analysing data via pivot tables - SQL knowledge is a nice to have

- Can work independently to drive workload and identify areas of opportunity

- Have experience troubleshooting and/or answering complex customer queries in a timely and professional manner

- Have previous experience with Billing systems and ERP systems (nice to have)

- Are proactive and curious in your way of working Curious

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Senior Billing & Revenue Manager and work closely with teams in Finance, Sales and Engineering . Our team of 3 is highly collaborative and dedicated to providing great support and improvement initiatives across the organisation.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Become a full-fledged SME on all things Billing.

- Become an active contributor in any projects you are part of to ensure your expertise allows the teams to achieve objectives.

- Identify or deliver a process improvement project.

- Be independent on daily activities once requiring support from team members for more complex projects.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in multiple areas such as Finance, Automation and multiple system usage.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.…
